pattern: Modal dialog (native <dialog>, inert background) containing a WAI-ARIA 1.2 combobox whose listbox is always shown: focus stays in the search field and aria-activedescendant points at the active option. Section headers are presentational rows; the active option always stays rendered while the list is virtualized.

aria.value: the nested page trail while on a nested page

keyboard.action: Open or close the palette (the shortcut option).
Choose the active result: run it, or open its nested page.

keyboard.context: Empty search field on a nested page

keyboard.action: Close and return focus to where it was.
Stays inside the modal dialog (native focus containment).

focus: Opening moves focus to the search field and remembers the previously focused element; closing (Escape, backdrop click, or a chosen command) restores it before the command runs. The background is inert while the dialog is open.
notes: The number of results is announced politely after typing pauses (WCAG 4.1.3); an empty result shows an Empty State with the reason.
The active result is shown by a start-edge bar as well as color (WCAG 1.4.1).
The shortcut is shown in the footer hints and next to each command with Kbd (with spoken names for symbols).
knownCaveats: Section names are visible headers but not part of the options' accessible names.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
